militia-drills.criticalSuccess: The drills go like clockwork. By the end, the farmhands march in step and talk about the realm like it's theirs to defend.
militia-drills.success: The drills come together. Nobody will mistake them for knights, but they know which end of the spear goes forward.
militia-drills.failure: Half the turnout is busy or bored, and the drills fizzle out before anyone learns much.
militia-drills.criticalFailure: The drills turn into a shoving match, someone gets hurt, and the whole thing ends in angry words.

watchtower-gap.criticalSuccess: A lookout goes up fast, and the first night it's manned the watch catches the smugglers in the act.
watchtower-gap.success: A lookout goes up, and the crossing quiets down once the smugglers notice someone's watching.
watchtower-gap.failure: The lookout never quite gets built, and the crossing stays open to anyone who wants it.
watchtower-gap.criticalFailure: While the work stalls, the smugglers grow bold enough to rob the work crew.

deserters.criticalSuccess: The runaways come back on their own after a quiet talk, and their story fixes the problems that made them run.
deserters.success: The runaways are found and brought back without a fuss. They grumble, but they stay.
deserters.failure: The runaways can't be found. Their bunks stay empty, and the others notice.
deserters.criticalFailure: The hunt for the runaways turns ugly, and the whole countryside takes their side.

arms-shipment.criticalSuccess: The deal is a steal: good steel at a fair price, with a little extra thrown in to seal the friendship.
arms-shipment.success: The deal goes through, and the armory is fuller for it.
arms-shipment.failure: Haggling drags on until the seller loses patience and takes the goods elsewhere.
arms-shipment.criticalFailure: The goods turn out to be rusted junk under a layer of grease, and the realm paid for the privilege.

road-tolls.criticalSuccess: The thugs are rounded up, and the tolls they took go back to the travelers they took them from.
road-tolls.success: The thugs are run off, and the road is free again.
road-tolls.failure: The thugs scatter when the watch comes, and drift back when it leaves.
road-tolls.criticalFailure: The watch is beaten off, and the toll goes up to pay for the trouble.

veterans-grievance.criticalSuccess: The old soldiers get a hearing, a feast, and a place of honor. They become the realm's loudest supporters.
veterans-grievance.success: The old soldiers are heard out and given something fair. The grumbling dies down.
veterans-grievance.failure: The old soldiers feel brushed off, and they're telling anyone who'll listen.
veterans-grievance.criticalFailure: The old soldiers march on the hall, and the crowd that gathers isn't on the leaders' side.

border-raid.criticalSuccess: The raiders are caught at the border with the herd. The animals come home, and so does a lesson for the raiders.
border-raid.success: The riders are chased off and most of the herd is brought back.
border-raid.failure: The trail goes cold past the border. The raiders keep what they took.
border-raid.criticalFailure: The pursuit rides into an ambush, and the raiders take more than cattle this time.

tournament.criticalSuccess: The contest is the talk of the season: good bouts, no broken heads, and a champion everyone cheers.
tournament.success: The contest goes off well. A few bruises, a lot of cheering.
tournament.failure: The contest is a damp, half-attended affair that nobody will remember.
tournament.criticalFailure: The contest turns into a brawl that spills into the fair and wrecks half the stalls.

hedge-witch.criticalSuccess: The real cause is found, the witch is cleared, and she becomes the village's favorite healer.
hedge-witch.success: The feud is settled with apologies on both sides and a cask of cider.
hedge-witch.failure: Nobody can prove anything either way, and the bad feeling lingers.
hedge-witch.criticalFailure: Accusations fly, charms start flying too, and both households lose more than goats.

book-bequest.criticalSuccess: The books find a home, and a few of them turn out to be priceless.
book-bequest.success: The books find a home where people will read them.
book-bequest.failure: The books sit in crates in a damp cellar, slowly going to mold.
book-bequest.criticalFailure: The books are lost to a leaky roof and a careless carter, and the scholar's family is furious.

marsh-lights.criticalSuccess: The lights are traced to a harmless marsh gas, and the herders turn it into a local wonder.
marsh-lights.success: The lights are explained, and the herders go back to their pastures.
marsh-lights.failure: Nobody gets to the bottom of the lights, and the herders keep their animals away.
marsh-lights.criticalFailure: Whatever the lights are, they lead a herder astray, and the marsh doesn't give him back.

apprentice-accident.criticalSuccess: The barn is rebuilt by the apprentice's own hands, and the lesson makes them a careful mage for life.
apprentice-accident.success: The damage is paid for and the apprentice is put under a stricter master.
apprentice-accident.failure: The matter is shrugged off, and folks start eyeing every apprentice warily.
apprentice-accident.criticalFailure: A second accident follows the first, and the village wants every spellcaster gone.

star-charts.criticalSuccess: The almanac is uncanny: the planting dates are perfect and the farmers swear by it.
star-charts.success: The almanac is useful, and a few farmers try their luck with it.
star-charts.failure: The almanac is full of guesses dressed up as stars.
star-charts.criticalFailure: The almanac gets the frost wrong, and the early planting is lost.

cursed-relic.criticalSuccess: The coin is laid to rest properly, and the luck it took comes back with interest.
cursed-relic.success: The coin is sealed away, and the bad luck stops.
cursed-relic.failure: The coin is locked in a box, but it keeps turning up in people's pockets.
cursed-relic.criticalFailure: The coin passes from hand to hand, and the misfortune follows it through the village.

schoolroom.criticalSuccess: The school opens with a good teacher, and the children take to it at once.
schoolroom.success: The school opens, and the children learn their letters.
schoolroom.failure: The school never gets past the planning, and the parents give up asking.
schoolroom.criticalFailure: The school opens with the wrong teacher, and it closes in disgrace.

fey-bargain.criticalSuccess: A fair deal is struck with the sprite, and the bridge becomes a lucky place to cross.
fey-bargain.success: The sprite accepts a fair offering and stops troubling folks.
fey-bargain.failure: The sprite refuses every offer, and folks take the long way round.
fey-bargain.criticalFailure: The sprite takes offense, and its pranks follow people home.

irrigation.criticalSuccess: The ditch is dug true, and the lower fields have their best year ever.
irrigation.success: The ditch is dug, and the lower fields drink.
irrigation.failure: The digging stalls halfway, and the ditch fills with mud.
irrigation.criticalFailure: The ditch floods the wrong field and drowns the crop in it.

blight.criticalSuccess: The rust is burned out early, and the treatment works so well it's taught across the realm.
blight.success: The rust is caught before it spreads.
blight.failure: The rust slows but doesn't stop, and one more field is lost.
blight.criticalFailure: The rust spreads from farm to farm, and the granaries will feel it.

bridge-damage.criticalSuccess: The new bridge is better than the old one, and the miller throws a party to open it.
bridge-damage.success: The bridge is mended and the long way round is forgotten.
bridge-damage.failure: The repair is slow and shaky, and folks still go the long way.
bridge-damage.criticalFailure: The patched bridge gives way under a loaded cart.

market-day.criticalSuccess: Market day is a roaring success, and merchants from three villages over ask when the next one is.
market-day.success: Market day comes off well, and coin changes hands.
market-day.failure: Market day is quiet: a few stalls, fewer buyers.
market-day.criticalFailure: Market day ends in a fight over stall space, and the merchants swear they won't come back.

foul-well.criticalSuccess: The well is cleaned and the cause found, and the sick recover quickly.
foul-well.success: The well is cleaned and the sickness passes.
foul-well.failure: The well is boarded up, and folks haul water from the stream.
foul-well.criticalFailure: The foul water reaches more homes before anyone acts, and the sickness spreads.

new-settlers.criticalSuccess: The family settles in and works hard, and their letters home bring more like them.
new-settlers.success: The family is given land and gets to work.
new-settlers.failure: The family can't find good land and moves on.
new-settlers.criticalFailure: The family is cheated out of their land by a neighbor, and they leave bitter.

wolves-at-the-fold.criticalSuccess: The pack is driven off, and the shepherds' new dogs keep them away for good.
wolves-at-the-fold.success: The wolves are hunted down, and the flocks are safe again.
wolves-at-the-fold.failure: The hunters come back empty-handed, and the losses go on.
wolves-at-the-fold.criticalFailure: The hunt goes wrong, and it's not only sheep the wolves take this time.

roofs-and-rot.criticalSuccess: Every roof is mended before the rains, and the work gives idle hands a trade.
roofs-and-rot.success: The worst roofs are patched and folks stay dry.
roofs-and-rot.failure: A few roofs are mended, and the rest keep dripping.
roofs-and-rot.criticalFailure: A rotten roof gives way in the night and takes a family's home with it.

petitioners-line.criticalSuccess: Every petitioner is heard by sundown, and the ones with real troubles go home with answers.
petitioners-line.success: The line is worked through, and most folks leave satisfied.
petitioners-line.failure: The line barely moves, and folks go home tired and grumbling.
petitioners-line.criticalFailure: The doors close on a long line, and the crowd outside turns ugly.

whisper-campaign.criticalSuccess: The rumor is traced to its source, and the open books prove the leaders clean.
whisper-campaign.success: The rumor dies down once the truth is told plainly.
whisper-campaign.failure: The rumor fades a little, but folks still wonder.
whisper-campaign.criticalFailure: The denial makes it worse, and the story grows with every telling.

local-election.criticalSuccess: The choosing goes smoothly, and the new reeve is popular and loyal.
local-election.success: The choosing is blessed, and the village has its reeve.
local-election.failure: The choosing ends in a squabble, and nobody is happy with the result.
local-election.criticalFailure: The choosing splits the village down the middle, and the losers won't accept it.

bribed-official.criticalSuccess: The crooked reeve is exposed and the money paid back. The village cheers the crown.
bribed-official.success: The reeve is removed and a better one put in.
bribed-official.failure: The reeve is warned, but nobody believes anything has changed.
bribed-official.criticalFailure: The reeve slips through, and the villagers decide the crown is in on it.

royal-progress.criticalSuccess: The visit is a delight. The miller's family tells the story for years, and so does everyone who saw it.
royal-progress.success: The visit goes well and the village feels seen.
royal-progress.failure: The visit is short and stiff, and the village is a little let down.
royal-progress.criticalFailure: The visit goes badly wrong, and the village feels insulted.

informants.criticalSuccess: The barkeep's ear proves golden, and the realm hears about trouble before it starts.
informants.success: The arrangement works, and useful word comes in now and then.
informants.failure: The tips are mostly gossip and rarely worth the coin.
informants.criticalFailure: The arrangement is discovered, and the tavern regulars feel spied on.

succession-gossip.criticalSuccess: A clear answer is given, and the steadiness of it calms the whole realm.
succession-gossip.success: The worry is answered well enough, and the talk dies down.
succession-gossip.failure: The answer is vague, and the question keeps coming back.
succession-gossip.criticalFailure: The non-answer sets factions scheming over who would take the seat.

amnesty.criticalSuccess: The pardoned poachers turn gamekeepers, and they're the best the realm has ever had.
amnesty.success: The pardon holds, and the poachers settle down.
amnesty.failure: The pardon is offered, but the poachers don't trust it.
amnesty.criticalFailure: The pardoned poachers go straight back to it, and the realm looks a fool.

traveling-players.criticalSuccess: The players put on a show nobody will forget, and they promise to come back every year.
traveling-players.success: The players perform, the village laughs, and everyone is fed.
traveling-players.failure: The show is thin and the crowd thinner.
traveling-players.criticalFailure: The players mock the leaders on stage, and the crowd laughs along a little too hard.

shrine-dispute.criticalSuccess: A shared arrangement is found that both congregations are proud of.
shrine-dispute.success: A schedule is agreed, and the candles stay put.
shrine-dispute.failure: The bickering continues, quieter but not gone.
shrine-dispute.criticalFailure: The quarrel turns into shoving at the shrine door, and both faiths blame the crown.

harvest-festival.criticalSuccess: The supper and bonfire are the best in memory, and the village sings until dawn.
harvest-festival.success: The festival is warm and well fed.
harvest-festival.failure: The festival is rained out, and folks go home early.
harvest-festival.criticalFailure: The bonfire gets away from them and takes a haystack with it.

bad-omen.criticalSuccess: The omen is read as good fortune, and the village takes heart.
bad-omen.success: The omen is explained away, and folks go back to their work.
bad-omen.failure: Folks keep muttering about the omen.
bad-omen.criticalFailure: The omen spreads panic, and every misfortune is blamed on it.

local-legend.criticalSuccess: The tales are written down beautifully, and copies are passed hand to hand across the realm.
local-legend.success: The tales are written down before they're lost.
local-legend.failure: Only a few of the tales are saved.
local-legend.criticalFailure: The old woman takes offense at how her tales were treated and refuses to share any more.

vandalized-statue.criticalSuccess: The culprit is caught and does the cleaning, and the village has a good laugh about it.
vandalized-statue.success: The paint is scrubbed off and the vandal warned.
vandalized-statue.failure: The paint fades, but whoever did it is still out there.
vandalized-statue.criticalFailure: The vandal strikes again, bolder, and the pictures get worse.

wedding.criticalSuccess: The wedding is a joy, and both families count the realm as friends for life.
wedding.success: The wedding goes off well, with a leader there to witness it.
wedding.failure: The wedding is a stiff affair and the families feel slighted.
wedding.criticalFailure: The wedding ends in a quarrel between the families, and the crown gets the blame.

burial-rites.criticalSuccess: A fitting new ground is blessed, and folks find peace in it.
burial-rites.success: A new burial ground is set aside and accepted.
burial-rites.failure: The new plot is used, but nobody likes it.
burial-rites.criticalFailure: Folks refuse the new plot, and the bodies wait.

foreign-envoy.criticalSuccess: The visit is a triumph, and the realm gains a warm friend abroad.
foreign-envoy.success: The visit goes well, and letters keep coming.
foreign-envoy.failure: The visit is polite and goes nowhere.
foreign-envoy.criticalFailure: The visit goes badly, and the envoy leaves offended.

river-pirates.criticalSuccess: The pirates are caught red-handed, and the river is safe for a long while.
river-pirates.success: The pirates are driven off, and the barges sleep easy.
river-pirates.failure: The pirates go quiet for a while, then come back.
river-pirates.criticalFailure: The pirates grow bolder and take a whole barge.

border-dispute.criticalSuccess: The line is settled fairly, and both farmers shake hands on it.
border-dispute.success: The line is marked and the matter is closed.
border-dispute.failure: Neither side accepts the ruling, and the stones keep moving.
border-dispute.criticalFailure: The quarrel turns into a fight, and the neighbor's lord takes his side.

ferry-service.criticalSuccess: The ferry runs like clockwork, and trade on both banks picks up.
ferry-service.failure: The ferry runs when it feels like it.
ferry-service.criticalFailure: The ferry capsizes on its second crossing.

insulted-guest.criticalSuccess: The merchant leaves delighted and tells everyone how gracious the realm is.
insulted-guest.success: The merchant is soothed and the matter dropped.
insulted-guest.criticalFailure: The merchant tells the story everywhere, and it gets worse every time.

lost-boat.criticalSuccess: The boat is found with everyone safe, and the rescue is the talk of the lake.
lost-boat.success: The boat is found and the crew brought home.
lost-boat.failure: The boat is found, but not everyone came home.
lost-boat.criticalFailure: The search finds nothing, and another boat is lost looking.

hostage-exchange.criticalSuccess: The exchange goes smoothly and opens the door to a lasting truce.
hostage-exchange.failure: The talks stall, and the trapper is still held.
hostage-exchange.criticalFailure: The exchange goes wrong, and blood is spilled on both sides.

river-festival.criticalSuccess: The races are a riot of color and cheering, and folks come from all over to watch.
river-festival.success: The races are a happy day on the water.
river-festival.failure: The races are a soggy, small affair.
river-festival.criticalFailure: A race ends in a collision and a drowning.

counterfeit-coin.criticalSuccess: The forger is caught with the molds, and honest coin flows again.
counterfeit-coin.success: The false coins are pulled from circulation.
counterfeit-coin.failure: The false coins keep turning up, though fewer of them.
counterfeit-coin.criticalFailure: The false coin spreads, and merchants start refusing the realm's money.

new-workshop.criticalSuccess: The forge thrives and draws more craftsfolk in its wake.
new-workshop.success: The forge is lit and the first iron sold.
new-workshop.failure: The forge struggles and barely keeps its fire.
new-workshop.criticalFailure: The forge fails and the smith leaves owing money.

price-gouging.criticalSuccess: Fair prices return, and a second seller sets up shop to keep them fair.
price-gouging.success: The prices come back down to something fair.
price-gouging.failure: The prices drop a little, but folks still pay too much.
price-gouging.criticalFailure: The prices climb higher, and folks go without.

guild-charter.criticalSuccess: The guild is founded with fair rules, and the work it turns out is the best in the region.
guild-charter.success: The guild is chartered and sets fair wages.
guild-charter.failure: The guild talks go round in circles.
guild-charter.criticalFailure: The guild forms against the crown's wishes and starts making demands.

tax-dodgers.criticalSuccess: The missing tithes are found, with interest, and the village pays up willingly.
tax-dodgers.failure: Some of the tithes come in; the rest are still lost on the road.
tax-dodgers.criticalFailure: The village refuses to pay, and its neighbors start asking why they should.

mine-accident.criticalSuccess: The miners are dug out alive, and the rescue makes heroes of everyone who helped.
mine-accident.success: The miners are brought out alive.
mine-accident.failure: The rescue is slow, and one of the miners doesn't make it.
mine-accident.criticalFailure: The rescue fails, and the dig is abandoned.

merchant-caravan.criticalSuccess: The trade route blossoms, and more traders follow the first.
merchant-caravan.success: The route is set up and the caravan comes each month.
merchant-caravan.failure: The trader comes once or twice and then stops.
merchant-caravan.criticalFailure: The trader is robbed on the way, and the word on the road is to stay away.

debt-collector.criticalSuccess: The debts are settled fairly, and the families keep their homes.
debt-collector.success: The moneylender agrees to fairer terms.
debt-collector.failure: A few families are saved; others lose everything.
debt-collector.criticalFailure: The moneylender takes what he can, and families end up on the road.

trail-markers.criticalSuccess: The trails are marked so well that even strangers find their way.
trail-markers.success: The trails are marked and folks stop getting lost.
trail-markers.failure: Only some trails get marked before the work stops.
trail-markers.criticalFailure: The markers are set wrong and lead a party astray.

lost-hunters.criticalSuccess: The hunters are found alive, and they bring back word of good game.
lost-hunters.success: The hunters are found and brought home.
lost-hunters.criticalFailure: The searchers find nothing, and two of them go missing too.

poachers.criticalSuccess: The poachers are caught, and the snares they set feed the poor for a month.
poachers.failure: The snares are cleared, but they keep coming back.
poachers.criticalFailure: The poachers clear out the woods, and the crown's game is gone for a season.

wild-harvest.criticalSuccess: The harvest is plentiful and fetches a great price at market.
wild-harvest.success: The foragers bring in a good harvest.
wild-harvest.criticalFailure: The foragers eat something they shouldn't have, and the season ends in sickness.

strange-tracks.criticalSuccess: The creature is found and turns out to be harmless, and even a little lucky.
strange-tracks.success: The tracks are explained and the herders calm down.
strange-tracks.failure: Nobody can name the tracks, and the herders keep watch.
strange-tracks.criticalFailure: Whatever made the tracks comes back and takes a herd.

ruins-found.criticalSuccess: The ruins hold a real find, and scholars come to study them.
ruins-found.success: The ruins are cleared and recorded.
ruins-found.failure: The ruins are interesting but empty.
ruins-found.criticalFailure: The ruins wake something better left asleep.

forest-fire.criticalSuccess: The fire is stopped at the ridge, and the firebreak becomes a road.
forest-fire.success: The fire is put out before it reaches the village.
forest-fire.failure: The fire burns out on its own, after taking a lot of good timber.

frontier-scouts.criticalSuccess: The scouts come back with maps and stories, and their work opens new land.
frontier-scouts.success: The scouts bring back useful word of the land beyond.
frontier-scouts.failure: The scouts come back with little to report.
frontier-scouts.criticalFailure: The scouts run into trouble past the border, and not all of them come back.

land-grant.criticalSuccess: The grant is a fine investment, and the bigger shop serves the whole region.
land-grant.success: The land is granted and put to good use.
land-grant.failure: The grant is tangled in arguments over boundaries.
land-grant.criticalFailure: The grant offends the neighbors, who say the crown plays favorites.

unpopular-law.criticalSuccess: The law is changed in a way everyone can live with, and folks praise the leaders for listening.
unpopular-law.success: The law is softened and the anger cools.
unpopular-law.failure: The law stays, and folks keep grumbling.
unpopular-law.criticalFailure: The protest turns into a riot.

stolen-seal.criticalSuccess: The thief is caught with the seal and the forgeries are undone.
stolen-seal.failure: A new seal is made, but the forged permits keep turning up.
stolen-seal.criticalFailure: The forgeries spread, and nobody trusts a permit any more.

oath-day.criticalSuccess: The oath-taking is moving, and the new settlers are the realm's most loyal.
oath-day.failure: The ceremony is rushed and feels hollow.
oath-day.criticalFailure: The ceremony is botched, and the settlers feel unwelcome.

orphans.criticalSuccess: The children find loving homes, and their families are traced.
orphans.failure: The children are housed, but nobody really takes them in.
orphans.criticalFailure: The children run off, and nobody knows where they went.

sculptor.criticalSuccess: The carving is a marvel, and visitors come just to see it.
sculptor.success: The carving is fine work, and the village is proud of it.
sculptor.failure: The carving is fine, if plain.
sculptor.criticalFailure: The carving is a disaster, and the village is a laughingstock.

saints-day.criticalSuccess: The feast is a joyous day of prayer and food, and the shrine's fame spreads.
saints-day.criticalFailure: The feast is spoiled, and folks call it a bad sign.

bawdy-songs.criticalSuccess: The leaders answer with a better song, and the whole realm sings it.
bawdy-songs.success: The song fades as folks move on to the next tune.
bawdy-songs.criticalFailure: Every attempt to stop the song makes it more popular.

drill-accident.criticalSuccess: The farmhand heals well and the drills are made safe, and the militia is better for it.
drill-accident.success: The farmhand is cared for and the drills are fixed.
drill-accident.failure: The farmhand limps for the rest of his life, and recruits are harder to find.
drill-accident.criticalFailure: Another accident follows the first, and the militia falls apart.

old-fort.criticalSuccess: The old palisade is made strong again and becomes the pride of the border.
old-fort.success: The old palisade is patched and garrisoned.
old-fort.failure: The repairs drag on and the work is shaky.
old-fort.criticalFailure: The old palisade collapses during the work.

mercenaries.criticalSuccess: The sellswords prove loyal and keep the roads safe for a fair price.
mercenaries.success: The sellswords are hired and earn their pay.
mercenaries.failure: The sellswords take the coin and do little.
mercenaries.criticalFailure: The sellswords turn to banditry themselves.

siege-rumors.criticalSuccess: The rumor is put to rest quickly, and the barricades become a fine new wall.
siege-rumors.success: The rumor is shown to be false and the barricades come down.
siege-rumors.criticalFailure: The panic leads to a stampede.

hostile-delegation.criticalSuccess: The steward leaves calmed and even friendly.
hostile-delegation.criticalFailure: The steward leaves furious, and his lord takes it as an insult.

lake-trade.criticalSuccess: The trade flourishes, and both shores prosper.
lake-trade.failure: The trade is slow to start.
lake-trade.criticalFailure: The deal falls apart and both sides feel cheated.

smuggler-boats.criticalSuccess: The night boat is boarded at the landing with a hold full of untaxed goods, and the cargo goes to the treasury.
smuggler-boats.success: A few nights of lanterns on the bank, and the boat stops coming.
smuggler-boats.failure: The boat simply changes its route, and the lights-out runs go on downstream.
smuggler-boats.criticalFailure: The smugglers grow so bold they unload in broad daylight and laugh at the watch.

cultural-exchange.criticalSuccess: The scholar stays the whole season, writes warmly of the realm, and sends students the next spring.
cultural-exchange.success: The scholar's stay is pleasant and both sides learn a little.
cultural-exchange.failure: The scholar grows bored with village life and leaves early.
cultural-exchange.criticalFailure: The scholar takes offense at the hospitality and writes a scathing account back home.

forbidden-book.criticalSuccess: Every copy is found and burned with the proper rites, and the nightmares stop the same night.
forbidden-book.success: The book is locked away where it can't hurt anyone.
forbidden-book.failure: The peddler sold more copies than anyone knew, and a few are still out there.
forbidden-book.criticalFailure: The book is copied and passed around in secret, and the nightmares spread with it.

enchanted-tools.criticalSuccess: The charmed plow cuts like a hot knife, and every farmer in the valley wants one.
enchanted-tools.success: The charm holds and the plow stays sharp all season.
enchanted-tools.failure: The charm fades before the season is out.
enchanted-tools.criticalFailure: The charm goes wrong, and the plow drags its ox through a neighbor's fence.

weather-witch.criticalSuccess: The witch is cleared, and her weather-sense saves the next harvest from a late frost.
weather-witch.success: The hail is shown to be bad luck, not a curse, and the witch is left in peace.
weather-witch.failure: Nobody can say whether she did it, and the farmers keep giving her hard looks.
weather-witch.criticalFailure: The village drives the witch out, and the hail comes again anyway.

lecture-tour.criticalSuccess: The lecture fills the hall twice over, and a dozen young people take up the stars.
lecture-tour.success: The lecture is well attended and talked about for days.
lecture-tour.failure: A handful of people come, and half of them fall asleep.
lecture-tour.criticalFailure: The lecturer mocks a local belief, and the crowd breaks up the talk.

bank-run.criticalSuccess: The crown's backing stops the panic in a day, and the moneylender ends up trusted more than before.
bank-run.success: The panic is calmed before the moneylender runs dry.
bank-run.failure: The panic burns out, but not before some families lose their savings.
bank-run.criticalFailure: The moneylender goes under, and the savings of half the village go with him.

new-quarry.criticalSuccess: The stone is the finest in the region, and builders send for it from far away.
new-quarry.success: The quarry is opened and the first stone cut.
new-quarry.failure: The seam turns out thinner and cruder than it looked.
new-quarry.criticalFailure: The pit collapses on the first crew to work it.

strike.criticalSuccess: A fair deal is struck, and the mill hands go back to work cheering.
strike.success: The mill hands and the owner settle on new wages.
strike.failure: The strike drags on and the mill sits idle.
strike.criticalFailure: The strike turns to fists and broken windows.

luxury-trade.criticalSuccess: The furs fetch a princely sum, and the buyers ask for the same again next season.
luxury-trade.success: The furs are sold at a fair price.
luxury-trade.failure: The furs go for less than the trappers hoped.
luxury-trade.criticalFailure: The furs are stolen on the road to market.

windmill.criticalSuccess: The windmill turns sweetly from the first breeze, and the farmers save days of hauling.
windmill.success: The windmill is raised and starts grinding.
windmill.failure: The windmill is built, but it turns only in a strong wind.
windmill.criticalFailure: The windmill blows down in its first storm.

flood.criticalSuccess: The banks are raised in time, and the new dikes protect the low fields for years.
flood.success: The water goes down with little harm done.
flood.failure: The low fields are lost for the season.
flood.criticalFailure: The water reaches the houses, and families flee to the hills.

orchard.criticalSuccess: Nearly every sapling takes, and in a few years the orchard is famous.
orchard.success: The saplings are planted and most of them take.
orchard.failure: Only a few saplings survive the first winter.
orchard.criticalFailure: The saplings carry a blight that spreads to the old trees.

locusts.criticalSuccess: The swarm is smoked out before it moves on, and the fields are saved.
locusts.success: The grasshoppers are driven off with little lost.
locusts.failure: One farm's crop is eaten to the ground.
locusts.criticalFailure: The swarm moves from field to field and the harvest suffers.

hermit.criticalSuccess: The hermit takes a liking to the realm and becomes its best guide in the deep woods.
hermit.success: The hermit shares a few of his paths.
hermit.failure: The hermit keeps his paths to himself.
hermit.criticalFailure: The hermit takes offense and sends travelers the wrong way.

bridge-trolls.criticalSuccess: The troll is outwitted at his own riddles and ends up keeping the bridge for the crown.
bridge-trolls.success: The troll is driven from the bridge.
bridge-trolls.failure: The troll stays, and folks take the long way round.
bridge-trolls.criticalFailure: A traveler gets a riddle wrong, and the troll has supper.

mapping-caves.criticalSuccess: Deep in the caves the mappers find something valuable, and the map is worth its weight in silver.
mapping-caves.success: The caves are mapped as far as anyone dares to go.
mapping-caves.failure: The mappers turn back before they get far.
mapping-caves.criticalFailure: A mapping party loses its light and takes days to find its way out, if it finds it at all.

wild-animals.criticalSuccess: The beast is brought down, and the whole village feasts on it.
wild-animals.success: The beast is driven back into the woods.
wild-animals.failure: The beast is still out there, and folks keep their children close.
wild-animals.criticalFailure: The beast charges again, and this time someone is badly hurt.

archaeological-find.criticalSuccess: The dig turns up treasures of an older people, and the whole realm is proud of its deep roots.
archaeological-find.success: The site gives up a few fine pieces and a story worth telling.
archaeological-find.failure: The ruin keeps its secrets this time.
archaeological-find.criticalFailure: The dig collapses on itself, and whatever was down there is buried again.

assassination-attempt.criticalSuccess: The killers are caught before they strike, and the one who hired them is named.
assassination-attempt.success: The attempt is foiled and the court is safe.
assassination-attempt.failure: The attempt fails, but the killers get away, and the court sleeps badly.
assassination-attempt.criticalFailure: A blade finds its mark, and the realm is shaken.

bandit-activity.criticalSuccess: The bandits are broken, and the roads are safer than they've been in years.
bandit-activity.success: The bandits are driven off the roads.
bandit-activity.failure: The bandits lie low, but they're still out there.
bandit-activity.criticalFailure: The bandits grow bolder and hit a settlement.

boomtown.criticalSuccess: The boom is handled well, and the town grows into a real center of trade.
boomtown.success: The boom brings good money to the realm.
boomtown.failure: The boom fizzles before anyone can make much of it.
boomtown.criticalFailure: The boom turns to chaos and crime.

building-demand.criticalSuccess: The townsfolk get their way, and they're delighted with the result.
building-demand.failure: The demand goes unanswered, and folks grumble.

crop-failure.criticalSuccess: The blight is stopped cold, and the fields recover.
crop-failure.failure: The blight takes a good part of the harvest.
crop-failure.criticalFailure: The blight spreads, and hunger follows.

cult-activity.criticalSuccess: The cult is rooted out and its captives freed.
cult-activity.success: The cult is pushed back, its hiding places found.
cult-activity.failure: The cult slips away to hide elsewhere.
cult-activity.criticalFailure: The cult grows bolder, and more people vanish.

diplomatic-overture.criticalSuccess: The envoy leaves with a firm promise of friendship and a gift for the court.
diplomatic-overture.success: The talks go well and the envoy promises to write.
diplomatic-overture.failure: The talks are polite and end with nothing agreed.
diplomatic-overture.criticalFailure: The envoy leaves insulted, and the neighbor's court hears all about it.

discovery.criticalSuccess: The breakthrough is real, and the realm's scholars are the talk of the region.
discovery.success: The work bears fruit, and the scholars have something to show for it.
discovery.failure: The breakthrough doesn't come, and the notes go back on the shelf.
discovery.criticalFailure: The experiment goes badly wrong, and a workshop burns.

drug-den.criticalSuccess: The den is raided, its suppliers caught, and the streets clear within a month.
drug-den.failure: The den closes, but it opens again a few streets over.
drug-den.criticalFailure: The poison spreads further while the watch looks the other way.

economic-surge.criticalSuccess: The realm rides the boom well, and the treasury swells.
economic-surge.success: The markets do well and the realm takes its share.
economic-surge.failure: The boom passes the realm by.
economic-surge.criticalFailure: The boom collapses into a slump, and debts are called in.

expansion-demand.criticalSuccess: The settlers are given new land and bless the crown for it.
expansion-demand.success: The demand is met for now.
expansion-demand.failure: The settlers grow restless and start looking past the border.
expansion-demand.criticalFailure: The settlers take matters into their own hands and move on land that isn't theirs.

festive-invitation.criticalSuccess: The court shines at the festival, and the friendship between the two realms deepens.
festive-invitation.success: The visit is a pleasant one.
festive-invitation.criticalFailure: The visit ends in an embarrassing scene that both courts will remember.

feud.criticalSuccess: The two families are reconciled, and a marriage seals the peace.
feud.success: The feud is calmed with a hard-won truce.
feud.failure: The feud smolders on, waiting for a spark.

food-shortage.criticalSuccess: Careful rationing and a few clever deals see the realm through without anyone going hungry.
food-shortage.success: The granaries hold out until the next harvest.
food-shortage.failure: Some families go hungry before the shortage ends.
food-shortage.criticalFailure: Hunger turns to anger, and the anger turns on the crown.

food-surplus.criticalSuccess: The surplus is stored and traded wisely, and the realm will eat well for a long time.
food-surplus.success: The surplus is put to good use.
food-surplus.failure: Much of the surplus spoils before anyone can use it.
food-surplus.criticalFailure: The surplus is squandered in a season of waste.

good-weather.criticalSuccess: The fine weather is put to full use, and the whole realm is in good spirits.
good-weather.failure: The weather turns before anyone can make the most of it.
good-weather.criticalFailure: The fine spell breaks into a violent storm.

inquisition.criticalSuccess: The zealots are calmed with patience and plain words, and neighbors make peace.
inquisition.failure: The zealots keep preaching on the street corners.
inquisition.criticalFailure: The zealots turn on their neighbors, and blood is spilled.

justice-prevails.criticalSuccess: The verdict is celebrated in the streets, and faith in the crown grows.
justice-prevails.success: The realm takes heart from it.
justice-prevails.criticalFailure: The case is reopened and the old wrong comes back.

land-rush.criticalSuccess: The rush is managed with fair surveys, and the new land is settled in good order.
land-rush.failure: The quarrels over the land go on.
land-rush.criticalFailure: The quarrels turn violent at the border.

local-disaster.criticalSuccess: The response is swift, and the settlement rebuilds stronger than before.
local-disaster.failure: The damage is heavy, and it will take a long time to put right.
local-disaster.criticalFailure: The disaster spreads before anyone can stop it.

monster-activity.criticalSuccess: The beast is slain, and its hide hangs in the hall.
monster-activity.success: The beast is driven back into the wild.
monster-activity.failure: The beast is still out there.

natural-disaster.criticalSuccess: The realm weathers it well, and the way everyone pulled together is remembered.
natural-disaster.criticalFailure: The disaster devastates whole stretches of the land.

natures-blessing.criticalSuccess: The wonder draws visitors from far away, and the realm's name spreads with them.
natures-blessing.success: The realm enjoys the wonder while it lasts.
natures-blessing.failure: The wonder fades before many people see it.
natures-blessing.criticalFailure: Careless visitors trample the wonder into nothing.

new-subjects.criticalSuccess: The newcomers settle in quickly and add to the realm's strength.
new-subjects.failure: The newcomers struggle to fit in.
new-subjects.criticalFailure: The newcomers are turned away, and they leave bitter.

noblesse-oblige.criticalSuccess: The family's gift turns the town into a jewel of the realm.
noblesse-oblige.success: The town is made a little finer.
noblesse-oblige.failure: The gift is smaller than promised.
noblesse-oblige.criticalFailure: The gift comes with strings that cause trouble at court.

outstanding-success.criticalSuccess: The work is celebrated far and wide, and the realm basks in it.
outstanding-success.success: The work brings the realm some pride.
outstanding-success.criticalFailure: The work is stolen and claimed by someone else.

pilgrimage.criticalSuccess: The pilgrims are welcomed and cared for, and the shrines' fame grows.
pilgrimage.failure: The pilgrims pass through without much fuss.
pilgrimage.criticalFailure: The pilgrims bring trouble with them, and the roads are crowded with it.

plague.criticalSuccess: The sickness is stopped early, and the healers are heroes.
plague.failure: The sickness takes many before it passes.
plague.criticalFailure: The sickness spreads across the realm.

political-calm.criticalSuccess: The quiet season is used well, and the realm gets a great deal done.
political-calm.criticalFailure: The calm shatters in a burst of quarreling.

public-scandal.criticalSuccess: The scandal is turned around, and the official comes out of it cleared.
public-scandal.criticalFailure: The scandal grows with every new detail.

remarkable-treasure.criticalSuccess: The treasure is shared well and enriches the realm.
remarkable-treasure.criticalFailure: The treasure starts a feud over who it belongs to.

sacrifices.criticalSuccess: The cult behind the disappearances is found and destroyed.
sacrifices.failure: The disappearances slow, but don't stop.
sacrifices.criticalFailure: More people are taken from the roads.

sensational-crime.criticalSuccess: The criminal is caught in a famous arrest that the bards will sing about.
sensational-crime.criticalFailure: The criminal strikes again, more boldly than ever.

squatters.criticalSuccess: The families are given homes, and they turn out to be good neighbors.
squatters.success: The squatters are settled somewhere better.
squatters.failure: The squatters stay where they are.
squatters.criticalFailure: The squatters' camp grows, and so does the trouble.

undead-uprising.criticalSuccess: The dead are laid to rest for good, and the graveyards are quiet again.

unexpected-find.criticalSuccess: The glowing find is a wonder, and scholars come to see it.
unexpected-find.failure: The find is a curiosity and nothing more.
unexpected-find.criticalFailure: The find turns out to be dangerous.

vandals.criticalSuccess: The vandals are caught and made to repair what they wrecked.
vandals.failure: The vandals still strike now and then.
vandals.criticalFailure: The damage spreads night after night.

visiting-celebrity.criticalSuccess: The visit is a triumph, and the celebrity tells everyone about the realm.
visiting-celebrity.criticalFailure: The visit is a disaster, and the celebrity says so loudly.

wealthy-immigrant.criticalSuccess: The estate is built, and the newcomer's money enriches the capital.
wealthy-immigrant.failure: The newcomer changes their mind and leaves.
wealthy-immigrant.criticalFailure: The newcomer causes trouble with the old families.

claim-hex.criticalSuccess: Surveyors stake out the new land, and the first families are already moving in.
claim-hex.success: The banner goes up over new land.
claim-hex.failure: The claim doesn't take this time.
claim-hex.criticalFailure: The claim ends badly, and the effort is wasted.

build-road.criticalSuccess: The road is laid straight and true, and wagons roll on it before the last stone is set.
build-road.failure: The road crew can't finish the stretch.
build-road.criticalFailure: The road washes out before it's done.

establish-farmland.criticalSuccess: The new fields are rich, and the first harvest promises plenty.
establish-farmland.success: The fields are cleared and planted.
establish-farmland.failure: The ground won't take a plow this season.
establish-farmland.criticalFailure: The work ruins the ground for a while.

establish-work-site.criticalSuccess: The work site is up and running, and the first loads are already coming in.
establish-work-site.success: The work site is set up.
establish-work-site.criticalFailure: The work site collapses on the crew.

found-settlement.criticalSuccess: The new village rises fast, full of hope and hammering.
found-settlement.failure: The settlers lose heart, and the founding stalls.
found-settlement.criticalFailure: The founding fails, and the settlers scatter.

build-structure.criticalSuccess: The building goes up ahead of time, and the town turns out to admire it.
build-structure.failure: The building isn't finished this time.
build-structure.criticalFailure: Part of the building comes down during the work.

fortify-hex.criticalSuccess: The fortifications are strong, and anyone watching takes note.

muster-troops.criticalSuccess: The troops muster in fine order, proud and ready.
muster-troops.criticalFailure: The muster turns into a brawl.

signature-ekundayo.criticalSuccess: Ekundayo's hunt is a triumph, and the hides and meat fill the stores.
signature-ekundayo.success: Ekundayo brings back a good haul.
signature-ekundayo.criticalFailure: The hunt goes wrong out in the wild.

signature-jubilost.criticalSuccess: Jubilost finds a hidden fortune in the ledgers and is insufferable about it.
signature-jubilost.success: Jubilost finds money the realm was owed.
signature-jubilost.failure: Jubilost finds little worth the trouble.
signature-jubilost.criticalFailure: Jubilost's digging upsets people who'd rather the books stayed closed.

signature-linzi.criticalSuccess: Linzi's tale of the leaders is on every tongue, and it gets better each time it's told.
signature-linzi.criticalFailure: Linzi's story gets garbled into something embarrassing.

signature-nok-nok.criticalSuccess: Nok-Nok comes back with eager new recruits who scare the realm's enemies more than its friends.
signature-nok-nok.success: Nok-Nok finds a few willing monsters.
signature-nok-nok.failure: Nok-Nok comes back alone and sulking.
signature-nok-nok.criticalFailure: Nok-Nok's recruits cause more trouble than they're worth.

signature-tristian.criticalSuccess: Tristian's wards and remedies are ready for whatever comes, and folks feel safer for it.
signature-tristian.criticalFailure: Tristian's work goes wrong, and he's crushed about it.

signature-valerie.criticalSuccess: Valerie drills the troops until they move like one body, and she's almost satisfied.
signature-valerie.criticalFailure: The drills end in injuries and bad blood.

signature-harrim.criticalSuccess: Harrim's doom-preaching somehow lifts every heart that hears it.
signature-harrim.failure: Harrim preaches to an empty square.

signature-jaethal.criticalSuccess: Jaethal's feast is the stuff of legend, and everyone who was there is proud to say so.
signature-jaethal.success: Jaethal's feast is a fine night.
signature-jaethal.failure: The feast is extravagant and dull.
signature-jaethal.criticalFailure: The feast goes too far and the scandal follows.

signature-kalikke.criticalSuccess: Kalikke's plan is a masterpiece, and every trouble has a careful answer.

signature-kanerah.criticalSuccess: Kanerah's false victory is believed everywhere, and spirits soar.
signature-kanerah.success: The story of the victory spreads.

signature-regongar.criticalSuccess: Regongar's march cows the worst streets in the realm.

public-outbreak.criticalSuccess: Calm voices and quick quarantines turn the fear into resolve, and the realm braces together.
public-outbreak.success: The fear is talked down before it turns to panic.
public-outbreak.failure: The fear keeps spreading from village to village.
public-outbreak.criticalFailure: The fear boils over, and neighbors turn on anyone who looks sick.

too-close-to-home.criticalSuccess: The thing is hunted down before it hurts anyone else, and the family is cared for.
too-close-to-home.success: The creature is tracked and destroyed.
too-close-to-home.failure: The creature slips away into the countryside.
too-close-to-home.criticalFailure: The creature strikes again before anyone can find it.

urban-outbreak.criticalSuccess: The monster is cornered and killed in the square, and the town cheers its defenders.
urban-outbreak.success: The monster is put down, though the street is a wreck.
urban-outbreak.failure: The monster is driven off but not killed.
urban-outbreak.criticalFailure: The monster tears through the town before it's stopped.
